review_candidates.description: Senior Engineer (Systems) We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to lead the engineering, integration, testing, commissioning, and lifecycle management of complex industrial systems across major Oil & Gas EPC projects. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in integrated systems engineering, multidiscipline coordination, system integration, and commissioning within Oil & Gas, Power, Utilities, or Industrial Infrastructure projects. YOUR ROLE As Senior Engineer (Systems) , you will be responsible for ensuring seamless integration between electrical, instrumentation, automation, communication, control, and SCADA systems while supporting successful project execution from engineering design through commissioning and final handover. Systems Engineering & Design Leadership Lead system engineering activities throughout the entire project lifecycle. Review and validate system architectures, engineering deliverables, network layouts, and functional design specifications. Develop and review system integration philosophies and engineering solutions. Ensure compliance with project requirements, client specifications, international standards, and contractual obligations. Participate in design reviews, HAZOPs, constructability assessments, and technical workshops. Ensure interoperability between all project systems. Integrated Systems Management Responsible for engineering and integration of: Power & Electrical Systems Power House Systems Electrical Distribution Systems MV/LV Systems Switchgear Systems UPS & Battery Systems Emergency Power Systems Generator Control Systems Substation Systems Protection & Control Systems Substation Automation Systems (SAS) IEC 61850 Systems Relay Coordination Systems SCADA Systems Oil & Gas Control Systems Distributed Control Systems (DCS) Emergency Shutdown Systems (ESD) SCADA Systems Fire & Gas Systems (FGS) PLC-Based Control Systems Plant Monitoring Systems Communication Systems Fiber Optic Networks Industrial Communication Networks Telecommunication Systems CCTV Systems Access Control Systems Public Address & General Alarm Systems (PAGA) Multidisciplinary Coordination Coordinate interfaces between Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, Construction, and Operations teams. Manage interface registers and integration matrices. Resolve engineering conflicts and interface challenges. Ensure alignment between engineering packages and vendor deliverables. Lead technical coordination meetings with project stakeholders. System Integration, Testing & Commissioning Develop and execute system integration strategies and plans. Coordinate interfaces among DCS, PLC, SCADA, SAS, FGS, and communication systems. Lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT). Participate in Site Acceptance Tests (SAT). Conduct Integrated System Testing (IST). Verify control logic, communication protocols, and overall system performance. Support startup, operational readiness, client acceptance, and final system handover. Cybersecurity & Reliability Support industrial cybersecurity implementation and compliance. Review network architecture and security controls. Support disaster recovery and business continuity planning. Drive reliability improvement initiatives to minimize downtime and enhance system availability. Quality, Safety & Compliance Ensure engineering deliverables meet project quality requirements. Review Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs). Participate in HAZID, HAZOP, and risk assessments. Support audits, inspections, NCR closure, and compliance reviews. Promote safe engineering practices and adherence to HSE standards. Vendor & Contractor Management Review technical bids and vendor proposals. Evaluate system suppliers and contractors. Coordinate vendor engineering, FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities. Monitor vendor performance and technical compliance. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Experience Minimum 10-15 years of engineering experience. Minimum 7 years within: Oil & Gas, Power, Utilities, Industrial Infrastructure, EPC Projects, Energy Sector Proven experience in: Integrated systems engineering, System integration and commissioning, Multidisciplinary engineering coordination, Power Houses and Substations, Process Facilities and Industrial Plants Education and Certifications Bachelor's Degree in: Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Systems Engineering, Control Engineering, Or related Engineering discipline Certifications in: Automation, SCADA Systems, Industrial Control Systems, Digital Engineering Skills and Competencies The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong knowledge of: Systems Engineering Integrated System Design DCS Engineering PLC & SCADA Systems Substation Automation Systems (SAS) IEC 61850 Control System Integration Industrial Communication Networks Testing & Commissioning Functional Safety Concepts Industrial Cybersecurity Awareness Vendor Management Project Engineering Risk Assessment Engineering Documentation Technical Problem Solving Interface Management WHAT WE OFFER The chance to contribute to some of UAE’s Oil and Gas EPC Mega projects. A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. Opportunities for professional growth and career progression. Competitive salary and benefits package. Ready to be part of our team? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success. Apply today and be part of something excellent!

review_candidates.title: IT Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Oxygen Conservation is entering one of the most important chapters of its growth. Expanding our IT support and accelerating our adoption of AI across the whole organisation are crucial to our next steps. We want an IT Coordinator who can move at pace, anticipate our needs before they arise, and help the whole team get substantially more from AI. This requires someone with genuine curiosity, strong interpersonal skills, solid technical foundations, and the kind of drive that makes things happen without being prompted. As passionate as you likely are about IT, to be truly fulfilled you might be looking for more. You may be seeking a role that’s challenging and rewarding in equal measure, amazing colleagues, a culture of care for people, and a mission you believe in. That is what you will find with Oxygen Conservation. We are working hard to fight the climate crisis and reverse the biodiversity collapse. The team is small by design, fast-moving by necessity, and deeply committed to everyone who works with us. We care about the people in this team, and we want to give you the opportunity to make a real difference, not just to our IT infrastructure but to how the whole organisation does its best work every single day. ABOUT YOU Are you curious, organised, and genuinely motivated to help people? The kind of person who takes pride in fixing a problem before someone else notices it, who follows up without being asked, and who brings energy to every interaction, whether you’re troubleshooting a connectivity issue or tracking down a missing document. Here is a snapshot of the strengths you’ll bring: ENVIRONMENT A genuine passion for the natural world and a conviction that scaling conservation is one of the most important challenges of our time. IMPACT Hands-on experience of administering a Microsoft 365 environment - users, licences, and permissions plus a working understanding of how accounts and access are kept in good order. Practical experience of setting up, securing and supporting laptops and mobile devices for people who work remotely. Strong knowledge of IT fundamentals, hardware, software, and connectivity, and the curiosity to keep learning. Genuine enthusiasm for AI tools, with a willingness to explore how they can be used practically in day-to-day work. The kind of initiative that means small problems get solved quickly and bigger ones get escalated with the right context already gathered. ADVENTURE Comfortable with variety and energised by a busy, changeable environment. The ability to move quickly, communicate clearly, and know when to ask for help. TOGETHERNESS Strong ability to communicate clearly with people of all technical backgrounds, from the most tech-savvy team member to someone who just needs their laptop to work. Able to build trust quickly and take ownership of your commitments, following through without needing to be chased. The defining characteristic of the right person is a genuine desire to help others, with a passion for delivering reliable, friendly IT support in a high-performance environment. At Oxygen Conservation, character matters more than capability. We recruit for potential, not experience. Of course, the IT foundations need to be there, because you’ll be trusted with the systems the whole team relies on but the service mindset matters more. And the genuine curiosity about AI and the future of work matters most of all. We are committed to having a genuinely diverse team drawn from across the country, with a wide range of lived and learnt experiences. You might have skills in some, but not all, of the areas above. Whatever your background, we would love to hear from you if you think you can make a real difference with Oxygen Conservation. ABOUT THE ROLE The IT Coordinator will work within the People and Performance team and will be OC’s primary internal IT contact. You will work alongside Oxygen House, our IT partner, in a genuinely collaborative relationship, building toward greater OC independence over time. You are joining at an exciting moment as we scale and invest in how our team uses technology. You will be hands-on from day one, and the role is yours to shape. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Internal IT Support Provide fast, high-quality, and proactive support to the whole team, ensuring hardware, software, and connectivity across the team are well-maintained, secure, and fit for purpose. Work alongside Oxygen House to maintain infrastructure, security, and compliance. Own the practical side of joiners, movers and leavers - accounts, access and devices, so people are productive on day one and access is removed promptly when they leave. Maintain organised records, including our asset register, software and licence records, and access documentation, to ensure information is always accurate and accessible. AI and Technology Adoption Support team members in accessing and making effective use of AI tools in their day-to-day work, training and coaching to build AI confidence and mastery across the team. Identify and implement practical AI productivity improvements. Help the team use AI safely as well as effectively - supporting our guidance on acceptable use and data handling and flagging where it needs to change. Stay at the cutting edge of AI and technology developments, bringing relevant, actionable insights back to the organisation. IT Operations and Improvement Identify and recommend technology improvements that help OC work better, faster, and more intelligently. Maintain and improve IT documentation, processes, and systems to ensure they remain accurate, useful, and easy to follow. KEY SUCCESSES Within your first six months, success will look like: A reputation across the team for fast, friendly, and reliable IT support that removes friction and helps people do their best work. Accurate and up-to-date documentation and systems records that we can rely on and makes workflows smoother and faster. Joiners and leavers handled smoothly and consistently, every time. A visible and positive contribution to how the team engages with and benefits from AI tools. ABOUT US We’re building the UK’s first genuine natural capital portfolio, acquiring large landscapes, restoring them, and creating investable natural capital products like premium carbon credits, biodiversity units, renewable energy partnerships, and ecotourism experiences (you can check them out at Oxygen Escapes). In just four years, we’ve grown to a valuation of around £400m with 50,000+ acres owned and helped connect over half a million acres for nature. Our mission is simple: prove that restoring ecosystems can deliver transformative environmental, social, and financial returns. Our work hasn’t gone unnoticed. In 2022, we were named Start-Up of the Year at the Business Leader South West Awards, followed by Team of the Year at the 2023 Edie Awards and our nature funding agreement with Triodos won ESG Deal of the Year at the 2024 Insider South West Dealmakers Awards. Our founder and CEO, Dr Rich Stockdale, is featured in the ENDS Power List as one of the top 100 UK environmental professionals driving significant impact and was shortlisted for Edie’s Leader of the Year Award in 2024. KEY INFORMATION Term: Full time, permanent Location: Remote with travel to OC offices and estates for team events and meetings, approximately once per month Closing date: When we find the right person Salary: The salary range for this role is £28,000 to £35,000. We typically bring people in toward the lower end of the range, with salary increasing as a result of strong performance.

review_candidates.title: System Specialist
review_candidates.description: Systémový specialista / IT konzultant Proč číst dál? Budete se starat o IT prostředí našich zákazníků počínaje koncovými zařízeními s přesahem do podnikové infrastruktury. Řešit a konzultovat technické problémy, navrhovat nová řešení a modernizace IT infrastruktury. Hledáme někoho, kdo má dobrý základ v IT technologiích a chce si dál rozšiřovat záběr. Důležitý je pro nás dobrý základ v IT infrastruktuře a chuť učit se další technologie.Nemusíte být expert či expertka. Co vás bude čekat na této pozici? Budete spravovat IT prostředí našich zákazníků – vzdáleně i přímo u nich. Součástí práce je podpora koncových zařízení a uživatelů. Řešit budete zejména Microsoft technologie (např. Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange, SQL nebo Remote Desktop Services). Dostanete se ke správě a rozvoji virtualizačního prostředí. Když se objeví složitější incident, budete hledat jeho příčinu a cestu k řešení. Postupně se můžete zapojovat do návrhů nových řešení, modernizací a migrací. Se zákazníky budete mluvit napřímo – nejen řešit, co nefunguje, ale také doporučovat, jak jejich IT prostředí zlepšit. Na technické části řešení budete spolupracovat s obchodním týmem. Obchod samotný ale zůstává na obchodnících. Jeden týden v měsíci budete držet pohotovost 24/7. Co očekáváme my od vás? Nečekáme člověka, který zná nazpaměť celý Microsoft svět. Potřebujeme ale někoho, kdo už má za sebou reálnou práci s IT infrastrukturou a dokáže technický problém samostatně rozebrat a řešit. Konkrétně se vám bude hodit: alespoň 2 roky zkušeností se správou IT infrastruktury nebo na podobné technické pozici, základní zkušenost se serverovými technologiemi Microsoft, orientace v sítích a koncových zařízeních, zkušenost s virtualizací nebo cloudovými technologiemi je výhodou, ne podmínkou, schopnost komunikovat se zákazníkem a technické řešení mu srozumitelně vysvětlit, angličtina pro práci s technickou dokumentací a běžnou pracovní komunikaci, řidičské oprávnění sk. B a ochota vyrazit za zákazníkem. Pokud část technologií zatím neznáte, není to automaticky stopka. Důležitější je pro nás technický základ, samostatnost a chuť posouvat se dál. Co vám přidáme navíc (k výplatě)? 😊 Služební vozidlo i k soukromému užití. Možnost využití HO. Placenou dovolenou i nad rámec standardních 25 dní. 30.000 Kč k narození miminka. review_candidates.title: Telecom Systems Team Lead
review_candidates.description: With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in IoT communication connectivity and associated services. We are a venture capital-backed company with a successful track record of satellite launches and are the first company in the world to disrupt the telecommunications industry by merging cellular 5G with satellites. Our technology has massive implications for the Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport sectors, particularly in the management and tracking of assets in remote and rural areas and in extending 5G coverage through non-terrestrial networks. As our wireless technologies continue to evolve and earn multiple awards, with funding for the next phase secured and strong commercial traction demonstrated, we are now looking to onboard a talented Telecom Systems Team Lead to join our engineering team in Luxembourg and contribute to the continued growth and success of our organization. The role is responsible for leading and growing OQ Technology's telecom engineering team and providing technical direction for the end-to-end telecommunication system underpinning the Company's 3GPP-based 4G/5G Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN). The Telecom Systems Team Lead brings together the Core Network, physical-layer/DSP, and protocol-stack disciplines into a coherent engineering roadmap, with accountability for the architecture, quality, and delivery of the telecommunication stack from research and prototyping through to operational deployment on the Company's satellite missions. The Telecom Lead manages the Senior Core Network Engineer, Core Network Engineer, DSP Algorithm Engineer, Telecom Engineer, and other engineers assigned to the telecom function, setting priorities, allocating work, developing technical talent, and providing technical and people-management leadership. Tasks Team Leadership and People Management Lead, manage, and grow the telecom engineering team, including the Senior Core Network Engineer, Core Network Engineer, DSP Algorithm Engineer, and Telecom Engineer, providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and performance management. Plan resourcing and recruitment for the team, define roles and career paths, and build the technical bench strength required to deliver the Company's telecommunication roadmap. Set individual and team objectives, conduct regular one-to-ones and performance reviews, and support the professional development of each team member. Foster a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture across the core network, DSP/physical layer, and protocol-stack disciplines, and ensure effective knowledge-sharing between them. Own the technical onboarding of new engineers and ensure consistent engineering standards, coding practices, and design-review discipline across the team. Technical Ownership and Architecture Hold overall technical authority for the architecture and evolution of OQ Technology's telecommunication system, spanning the Core Network (MME, SPGW, HSS, OAM, IREG, IPX, BCE and related functions), the physical layer/DSP chain, and the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack adapted for NTN. Define the technical roadmap and research strategy for new functions, algorithms, and system architectures for 4G/5G communication over Non-Terrestrial Networks, and align it with the Company's product and mission timelines. Review and approve system-level designs, ensuring consistency and interoperability across core network, baseband/DSP, and protocol-stack workstreams, and across the space, ground, and user segments. Set and enforce engineering standards, design-review practices, and quality gates for networking architectures and control algorithms against latency, high-availability, and Quality of Experience requirements, from prototype through operational deployment. Own system performance models and lead cross-functional systems-engineering activities related to end-to-end system performance optimisation. Guide the design and implementation of microservices-based, real-time and near real-time applications (e.g. resource management, NFV) and of DSP algorithms and baseband processing for the telecommunication payload and user terminals. Oversee the development, optimisation, and continuous upgrade of the protocol stack(s) supporting current and future missions, ensuring features are delivered against space and product team requirements. Approve subsystem budgets and specifications (e.g. RF link budget, power budget) and confirm regulatory and mission compliance in coordination with the systems engineering team. Delivery, Testing, and Operations Direct the full development lifecycle across the team, from concept, prototyping, and proof-of-concept experimentation through implementation, verification, integration, and deployment. Ensure rigorous validation of telecommunication software and hardware features through simulation, lab testing, and end-to-end testing in simulated NTN environments (e.g. using channel emulators). Oversee the maintenance, upgrade, and improvement of the internal telecommunications and RF lab, and ensure appropriate configuration control and version management of all deliverables. Support the space team with authoritative technical inputs for the design, optimisation, and maintenance of Operational and Demo Missions, including mission needs, expected performance, dependability, and safety goals. Own the resolution of escalations and cross-team technical blockers, and ensure timely, transparent reporting of progress and risks to senior management. Stakeholder, Partner, and Standards Engagement Lead technical discussions and negotiations with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, contractors, and research institutes, including evaluation of designs and acceptance of deliverables. Represent the Company in standardisation bodies (e.g. 3GPP, GSMA, ITU) and lead the Company's technical contributions to relevant standardisation activities. Own or contribute to technical documentation for project reviews, including ESA-related deliverables, and defend designs at formal project and customer reviews. Work with and support teams across OQ Subsidiaries and manage technical interfaces with external partners and contracting organisations. Planning and Reporting Participate in project management and planning activities, including proposals, roadmaps, budgets, and resourcing for the telecom engineering function. Provide regular reporting on team progress, technical risks, and delivery status to the Head of Engineering / CTO and other stakeholders. Ensure proper documentation of all technology development undertaken by the team and maintain traceability for audits and project reviews. Requirements Education Master's degree (or higher) in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. A PhD is a plus. Experience Significant professional experience (typically 8+ years) in telecommunications engineering, spanning at least two of the following domains: core network (EPC/5GC), physical layer/DSP, or protocol stack development. Proven experience leading or mentoring engineering teams, including performance management, technical coaching, and resource planning. Hands-on experience with 3GPP-based 4G/5G systems; experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) or satellite communications is highly desirable. Experience engaging with standardisation bodies (3GPP, GSMA, ITU) and managing relationships with external suppliers, MNO/MVNO partners, or research institutes. Track record of taking systems from research/prototype through to operational deployment, including verification and validation in lab and field environments. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of Core Network architecture and functions (MME, SPGW, HSS, OAM, IREG, IPX, BCE) and of NFV/microservices-based network applications. Solid understanding of physical-layer and DSP concepts (modem design, baseband processing, transceiver architecture) and of the NB-IoT/LTE/NR protocol stack. Proficiency with relevant development and simulation tools (e.g. C/C++, MATLAB, VHDL) and with CI/CD and version-control tools (e.g. Git). Familiarity with systems-engineering practices, including requirements derivation, performance modelling, and subsystem budgeting (e.g. RF link and power budgets). Leadership And Personal Skills Excellent leadership, coaching, and people-management skills, with the ability to develop technical talent and build a high-performing team. Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, able to engage effectively with senior management, external partners, and standardisation bodies. Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, able to balance strategic technical direction with hands-on problem-solving when required. Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus. Willingness to travel occasionally for partner, supplier, or standardisation meetings. Additional Information As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months. Benefits Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary - an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions. Flexibility to work remotely one day per week. Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects. A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities. Regular company events and team activities.
